idea: a race: slow decks get run over, fast (Hustle) decks hit harder
rules_added: Treadmill: The Sprinter's units have Hustle: they can attack the turn they arrive.
Interval Training: Your units with Hustle get +1 attack. Keep up!

idea: tough blockers; Beefcake cards come cheaper
rules_added: Heavy Plates: The Lifter's units get +0/+2.
Free Weights: Your Beefcake cards cost 1 less. The courtyard is open to all.

idea: swarms of cheap cards are capped; big single plays are not (and a deck change: necrocrat_beefcake, the prison guards)
rules_before: Smuggled Weights: He has been curling contraband plates under his bunk for years. The Brawler's units get +1 attack.
rules_added: Lights Out: You may play at most 2 cards a turn (Infrastructure does not count). The guards count heads.
Care Package: You start with one more card in your opening hand.

idea: a wall for ground attackers; flyers go over it
rules_added: Display Case: The Guard starts with a 0/4 Trophy Case on the field (Wallflower: it blocks, it never attacks).
Hall of Fame: Your units with Flying get +1 attack. Champions fly over the cases.
events_before: At half health a reserve guard steps off a pedestal: a 1/1 Reserve Guard joins.

idea: both sides start with Ingredients: a Gourmand deck makes better use of them
rules_added: Prepped: The Sous-Chef starts the fight with 2 Ingredients.
Staff Meal: You start the fight with 2 Ingredients as well. Help yourself.

idea: walls for ground attackers; flyers, Elusive units and direct damage go round them
rules_added: Walk-In Cooler: The Cook starts with two 0/4 Ice Blocks on the field (Wallflower: they block, they never attack).
Defrost: You start with one more card in your opening hand.

idea: swarms of 1-defence units pay for attacking; big units shrug it off
rules_added: Quality Control: Each unit that attacks the Golem takes 1 damage. Every unit is inspected.
Overtime Shift: You draw an extra card on your first turn.

idea: it hits harder; decks that heal gain more (and a staff meal on its 4th turn)
rules_added: Plate Up: The Expediter's units get +1/+0. Hot plates, coming through.
Tasting Spoon: Whenever you gain HP, you gain 1 more.
events_added: On its 4th turn the pass sends out staff meal: you heal 3.

idea: Tool decks are refused at the desk; unit decks are waved through faster
rules_added: Forms Only: You cannot play Tools in this fight. The form has no box for them.
Expedited: Your units get +1/+0.

idea: a slow grind punishes slow decks; a Contract to stop its best blocker
rules_added: Refund Policy: At the start of its turn the Clerk heals 1.
Receipt Kept: You start the fight with a Contract (pay 1, use it: exhaust target unit).

idea: trading units feeds it more; a Necrocrat deck pays less
rules_added: Burial Fees Waived: Your Necrocrat cards cost 1 less.
events_added: When two of its units have died, a permit is granted: two 1/1 Zombie Temps climb back up.

idea: win before the lift reaches the top; flyers get there first
rules_added: Express Lift: Your units with Flying get +1 attack. The shaft goes all the way up.
events_added: On its 4th turn the lift reaches the executive floors: the Operator's units get +1/+1.

idea: flyers come in over a slow deck; units that can swat them get stronger
rules_added: Crows: Every third turn of its, a 1/1 Crow with Flying flaps in.
Shoo!: Your units with Swat get +1 attack. Swatters can block flyers.

idea: a clock against slow decks; token decks grow faster
rules_added: Spore Cloud: At the start of its turn, you take 1 damage.
Fungal Feast: Your tokens get +1/+1.

idea: small attackers bleed on the thorns; big tramplers cut through
rules_added: Thorns: Each unit that attacks the Stalker takes 1 damage.
Hedge Cutter: Your units with Bulldoze get +1 attack.
events_added: On its 5th turn you find a clearing in the maze: you heal 3.

idea: a Garbage plan stalls; any deck heals a little each turn
rules_added: Bad Air: No one can use Garbage in this fight. The tunnel air spoils it.
Fresh Draught: At the start of your turn you heal 1.

idea: its units strike first; sturdier units survive it
rules_added: Pruning Shears: The Guard's units have Sucker Punch: they deal combat damage first.
Overgrowth: Your units get +0/+1.

idea: Wonder decks are turned away at the rope; everyone gets the audio guide (and a deck change: gourmand_refusemancer)
rules_added: Do Not Touch: You cannot play Wonders in this fight. Please do not touch the exhibits.
Audio Guide: You draw an extra card on your first turn.
events_added: At half health the Curator restores a portrait: it heals 3.

idea: a cap on very wide turns; Pathless cards come cheaper
rules_added: Correction Quota: You may play at most 3 cards a turn (Infrastructure does not count).
Approved Stamp: Your Pathless cards cost 1 less.
